groups.name: Intent requirement and validation
groups.rationale: Makes `--intent` a required flag on `start`, validates it before any git or model work, and maps the error code to exit 2 so agents know it is a command-line mistake.

groups.name: Intent parsing, validation and threading through start
groups.rationale: Parses `--intent` as a repeatable flag with order preservation, filters empty strings, validates presence, and threads intents through to session creation and output.

groups.name: Intent storage and retrieval in sessions
groups.rationale: Records intents on each round in the session store so they persist and can be echoed back and queried per round.

groups.name: Documentation and help text
groups.rationale: Updates README, skill descriptions, command help and spec to show `--intent` as required and repeatable, with examples and guidance on what makes a good intent statement.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
